label: Operating: Operates b: b exercises some activity, transient or immanent
definition: Operates b: b exercises some activity (operatio), transient (heating another) or immanent (understanding, willing). Wider than causing another (Ontic.Causes), which is only the transient case. Example: a knower understanding. Non-example: a stone merely resting. In Lean a parameter B -> Prop.
note: Stipulative analyst notion, attribution deferred. ST I q.75 a.2 co. ('non enim est operari nisi entis in actu') is the source use; its pinned claim is read only of causing another, so the generic version is an open analyst extension.
